scope: The 286 dataset records in the identified candidate review report
limitations: This records the user's approval instruction and supplied name; it does not assert independent source verification by the assistant.
Approval does not resolve missing data, chemical identity verification, permission uncertainties, or ingredient coverage.
The immutable candidate and per-row review statuses are unchanged. Applying row approval remains subject to the existing data contracts.
Supplemental extractions remain unnormalized candidates; this decision does not import them into runtime data.
